subject: EASA assurance mode PILOT -> ENFORCING

authorization.reference: owner instruction 2026-10-19: 'for enforcing mode i authorize'

effect: Satisfies the HUMAN_AUTHORIZATION precondition only. The mode is NOT switched: policy.request_mode stays fail-closed until a validated pilot record exists (pilot PASS, measured false-positive and false-negative rates, independent human review) and the EASA-T070 readiness decision is no longer NOT_READY (it also requires a READY package, which needs the human-written ASIL B safety evidence).
not_decided: No safety approval, no waiver of ASIL B evidence, no change of any gate.

independent_review.role: signs the independent human review of the pilot validation record (finding dispositions and error rates)
independent_review.independence_note: independent of the AI authors and inspectors that produced the pilot packages; the reviewer is also the owner who authorized PILOT and ENFORCING (not organisationally independent of the authorization)
independent_review.status: PENDING - nothing reviewed or signed yet
